titulo: Three strikes at midnight 🐒 Sun Wukong Part 2 #story #shorts
descripcion:
The Monkey King cries at his own feast: one day, Death will come for him too. So he sails into a storm to find a master who can teach him to live forever, and learns a secret hidden in three strikes of a ruler.

> Part 3: tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.
Would you have understood the three strikes?

From Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Wu Cheng'en, 16th century, chapters 1 and 2.
